name: Dynamic workflows
summary: Claude writes a script that runs many subagents in the background for big jobs like audits or migrations.
what: For large tasks, Claude can write a workflow: a JavaScript script that starts and coordinates many subagents. It runs in the background, so the conversation only gets the final answer. Saved workflows can be run again as a slash command.

impact.title: Bigger jobs
impact.detail: Spread work over tens or hundreds of agents.

impact.title: Clean context
impact.detail: Intermediate results stay out of the conversation.

impact.title: Checked results
impact.detail: Agents can cross-check each other before reporting.

howItWorks: Ask Claude to create a workflow, or use the ultracode keyword or /effort ultracode.
Runs use far more tokens; by default up to 16 agents run at once.
